Warn about recorded columns this pipeline does not carry forward

dot-warn_unused_openforis_columns.Rd

Several fields of the small-tree form are conditional on a plot-level switch and arrive empty in the exports seen so far: angle and distance_to_next_stem are collected only when the plot sets distance_stems = Yes, height_estimate only when a tree height was measured. None of them has a home in the output, which is harmless while they are empty and a silent loss the day a team switches them on.

Usage

.warn_unused_openforis_columns(trees)

Arguments

trees

Normalised tree data frame.

Value

NULL, invisibly. Called for its messages.

Details

taxa_vernacular_name is in the same position for a different reason: the form records it, the individuals table has nowhere to put it.
